name: jwt-session-cookie
title: HKDF-derived JWT browser sessions with authoritative version revocation
description: Adds purpose-separated HS256 JWT cookies, mandatory issuer/audience/type/expiry checks, uncached D1 owner versions and logout revocations, hardened host cookies, and strict mutation origins.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: tablePrefix
params.description: SQL table prefix to avoid conflicts.

params.name: cookieName
params.description: Cookie suffix; HTTPS uses __Host- and loopback HTTP uses dev_.

env.name: JWT_SESSION_ORIGIN
env.description: Canonical public origin, without a trailing slash. HTTPS in production; HTTP allowed only on loopback for local development.

secrets.name: JWT_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: At least 32 random bytes encoded as a string. HKDF derives the session key; rotating this secret signs out every browser.

routes.description: Current JWT session owner after authoritative state verification.
Revoke this JWT until its expiry and clear the browser cookie.
Rotate this owner's session version and clear the browser cookie.

agent.summary: Adds purpose-separated HS256 JWT cookies, mandatory issuer/audience/type/expiry checks, uncached D1 owner versions and logout revocations, hardened host cookies, and strict mutation origins.
when_to_use: Browser sessions that use the house HKDF/HS256/version pattern and need immediate logout or account-wide revocation.
when_not_to_use: Stateless authorization, cross-site cookies, public-key token verification, OAuth access tokens, or existing opaque sessions that already meet the product requirements.

adapt.title: Configure bindings
adapt.do: Set JWT_SESSION_ORIGIN to the canonical HTTPS origin without trailing slash; set JWT_SESSION_SECRET from at least 32 random bytes. Supply DB.

adapt.title: Issue after verified sign-in
adapt.do: After login proof, active-account and CSRF/OAuth-state checks, call createJwtSession with the trusted account id. Append setCookie to a private, no-store response.

adapt.title: Mount and protect browser APIs
adapt.do: Mount jwtSessionRoutes() at {{kit.routePrefix}}; apply requireJwtSession to other browser APIs.
adapt.check: Invalid sessions return 401; unsafe requests without exact Origin return 403.

adapt.title: Integrate account lifecycle
adapt.do: Await revokeOwnerJwtSessions after credential/identity recovery. Await setJwtSessionOwnerEnabled(false) on suspension/deletion; true only on authorized re-enable. Keep hooks consistent with account changes.
adapt.check: Old tokens fail after reset/disable and remain invalid after re-enable.

adapt.title: Maintain revocations
adapt.do: Await cleanupJwtSessionRevocations from scheduled maintenance. Never cache readJwtSession or its D1 authority checks.
adapt.check: Unexpired revocations survive; expired rows are removed in batches of 500.

agent.author_notes: JWT claims are visible, not encrypted. This is a cookie session profile, not an OAuth token or refresh flow. Every valid request reads D1 primary state. Host lifecycle hooks must disable owners and rotate versions after credential/identity changes; no password, account schema, browser UI or rate limiting is included.
